scope: Constructed public demonstration; no new learner acquisition or empirical comparison.

runtime.change: Call enable_load_extension(False) only if the optional Python API exists. Existing API failures are not suppressed; SQL authorization and query limits remain unchanged.

historical_evidence: Original acquisition records and exact extraction checks are retained privately. They are not bundled or independently authenticated by these hashes. The public Run86 report provides the study context.
origin_delivery: Run86 received the earlier method separately through seed/archive context; its initial compiled-method registry was empty. This is not one uninterrupted learning session or a direct populated-registry replacement.
authorship: SQL methods were model-authored in earlier studies. Run125 routing, applicability checks, constructed rows and ordinary reference are authored demonstration code. The public runtime portability change and extra regression test are engineering changes.
semantics: Hashes establish identity against this manifest, not truth, authentication or applicability. Physical-window bounds require declared interval support, nonnegative power, complete coverage and no peak/shape restriction; these are not claims about historical UCI data.
